entities.name: Keld
entities.description: A warrior nation in the cold western and northern Icehaven subcontinent of Aerona on Dominaria, whose people are feared conquerors and mercenaries.

entities.name: Keldons
entities.description: The tall, gray-skinned human people of Keld, organized into warhosts.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which Keld lies.

entities.name: Radha
entities.description: A warlord and the current leader of Keld, the last descendant of Astor, who has quietly revolutionized Keld.

entities.name: Kradak
entities.description: The first Doyen and founder of Keld, who led the original Keldons from Parma and forged a bond with the Mountain.

entities.name: Jezal
entities.description: The first Doyenne, leader of the stragglers, who made a pact with Kradak.

entities.name: Gatha
entities.description: A rogue student of Urza who experimented on the Keldons, transforming them into nightmarish warriors, and threw himself off a cliff rather than let Phyrexians have his secrets.

entities.name: Kreig
entities.description: A Doyen and witch-king, the mightiest Keldon ever, friend of Gatha.

entities.name: Kreyohl
entities.description: A Doyen who supported Gatha's work.

entities.name: Varden
entities.description: A Doyen who opposed Kreig and Gatha and was killed by Kreig.

entities.name: Gathans
entities.description: The Keldons transformed by Gatha's experiments, whom true-blooded Keldons later warred against.

entities.name: Greht
entities.description: The Gathan Doyen and leader defeated by Radha.

entities.name: Latulla
entities.description: The overseer who led the Prophecy War invasion of Jamuraa seeking Hero's Blood.

entities.name: Druik
entities.description: The Keldon warlord who co-led the Prophecy War and was killed.

entities.name: Gorsha
entities.description: A Doyenne and Speaker of the Council who defeated Latulla.

entities.name: Tajamin
entities.description: A Doyenne and Keeper of the Book of Keld who shattered the frozen lake with her sacred cudgel.

entities.name: Astor
entities.description: A warlord and later Doyen who made peace with Eladamri; a great hero of the Invasion and ancestor of Radha.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: The Elflord who made peace with Warlord Astor of Keld.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped defeat Latulla, helped Radha, and revealed the New Phyrexian threat.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: The Master Wizard who helped the Ki'pamu League and defeated Latulla.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A planeswalker whose sacrifice, with the destruction of the Skyshroud forest, healed Keld's rift.

entities.name: Garna
entities.description: A vicious, xenophobic warlord and possible challenger of Radha who leads a warhost devoted to the old ways.

entities.name: Aron Capashen
entities.description: The Benalish leader at the Oyster Bay summit.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A figure who, with Teferi, revealed the threat of a New Phyrexian invasion.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders who attacked Keld and raised the Keldon dead through necromancy.

entities.name: Prophecy War
entities.description: The Keldon invasion of Jamuraa shortly before the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Keldon Twilight
entities.description: The long-prophesied apocalyptic judgment that Keldons saw fulfilled in the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Gathan Wars
entities.description: The war in which true-blooded Keldons destroyed the Gathans.

entities.name: Keldon Necropolis
entities.description: Home of the Keldon honored dead, destroyed during the Twilight.

entities.name: Skyshroud Forest
entities.description: A forest transplanted into Keld by the Rathi Overlay, later destroyed.

events.summary: The original Keldons come from Parma under Kradak to escape the cold.
events.quote: The original Keldons came over from Parma led by Kradak to escape the deadly cold of that land.

events.summary: Keld is founded by the union of fire and hearth through Kradak's pact with Jezal.
events.quote: Thus Keld was founded by the union of fire and hearth.

events.summary: Gatha's experiments transform Keldons into nightmarish warriors, the mightiest being Kreig.
events.quote: His experiments transformed the Keldons into nightmarish warriors, the mightiest of which was the witch-king Kreig .

events.summary: Gatha throws himself off a cliff rather than let the Phyrexians learn his secrets.
events.quote: The researcher threw himself off a cliff to prevent the Phyrexians from discovering his secrets.

events.summary: Kreig injures the Phyrexian general and leaps off the same cliff.
events.quote: Inspired by his friend's heroic sacrifice, Kreig grievously injured the Phyrexian general before tossing himself off the same cliff in defiance of his foe.

events.summary: True-blooded Keldons regain the Doyen Council and make war on the Gathans.
events.quote: The true-blooded Keldons regained control of the Doyen Council and made war on the Gathans.

events.summary: The Keldons launch the Prophecy War, invading Jamuraa.
events.quote: A few months before the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria, the Keldons launched their invasion of Jamuraa.

events.summary: Latulla is defeated by Gorsha and Druik is killed at the Necropolis.
events.quote: Latulla was defeated by Doyenne Gorsha and Druik was killed.

events.summary: Teferi and Barrin defeat and destroy Latulla's banished followers in Jamuraa.
events.quote: were eventually defeated and destroyed by the planeswalker Teferi and Barrin the Master Wizard.

events.summary: Eladamri makes peace with Warlord Astor as Skyshroud overlays Keld.
events.quote: Skyshroud forest overlayed in Keld and Eladamri the Elflord made peace with Warlord Astor of Keld.

events.summary: Phyrexian necromancy raises the Keldon honored dead during the battle on the frozen lake.
events.quote: In the heat of battle, the Keldon honored dead were raised from their graves not by Twilight, but by Phyrexian necromancy.

events.summary: Tajamin shatters the frozen lake with her sacred cudgel, sinking most of both armies.
events.quote: In this time of greatest atrocity, Doyenne Tajamin cast her sacred cudgel into the frozen lake, shattering it into a thousand pieces.

events.summary: The Golden Argosy carries surviving Keldons to Urborg for the final battle against Yawgmoth.
events.quote: The Argosy then bore them off to Urborg where they fought in the final battle of the Invasion against Yawgmoth and his forces.

events.summary: With Teferi's help Radha defeats the Gathan Doyen Greht.
events.quote: With the help of Teferi , she became a great warlord in her own right and was able to defeat the Gathan Doyen Greht.

events.summary: Freyalise's sacrifice and the Skyshroud's destruction heal Keld's rift.
events.quote: With the sacrifice of the planeswalker Freyalise and the destruction of the Skyshroud forest, Keld's rift was finally healed allowing the nation to start the long road back to recovery and prosperity.

events.summary: Radha abolishes the taking of slaves as plunder.
events.quote: The taking of slaves as plunder has been abolished, and Keldons now learn industries and crafts.

events.summary: A peace summit at Oyster Bay between Radha's Keldons and Aron Capashen's Benalish is interrupted by Karn and Teferi's warning and revealed Phyrexian sleeper agents.
events.quote: The summit was interrupted when the planeswalkers Karn and Teferi revealed the threat of a New Phyrexian invasion and several of the Benalish knights turned out to be Phyrexian sleeper agents .

relations.note: Kradak is the founder of Keld.
relations.quote: Kradak : First Doyen and founder of Keld
Radha , the last descendant of the great Keldon hero Astor, led a resistance against the Gathans.
Gatha gained the support of the Doyen Kreyohl and was able to carry out his work in peace.

relations.note: Kreig then usurped Varden's war host.
relations.quote: After Kreig killed Varden and usurped what was left of his war host no one ever dared to challenge his might again.

relations.note: Garna is a possible challenger of Radha.
relations.quote: A prominent leader of this faction, and a possible challenger of Radha, is Garna , called the Bloodflame.
The campaign was named the Prophecy War and was led by Overseer Latulla and Warlord Druik

relations.note: Keld lies on Aerona's Icehaven subcontinent.
relations.quote: Keld is a warrior nation in the western and northern parts of Aerona 's cold Icehaven subcontinent on Dominaria .
